The story of FGC Ohafia Class of 2007 Al: The story of FGC Ohafia Class of 2007 Alumni Group – built on unity, service, and a lifelong commitment to one another.
The journey officially began when the la: The journey officially began when the late Ms. Ihuoma Ella, alongside three other pioneering members, created the WhatsApp group that would eventually grow into the vibrant alumni community we have today. The vision was simple but powerful: unity, support, and lifelong brotherhood and sisterhood.
From the beginning, the group was casual: From the beginning, the group was casual and inclusive. The first major milestone was the collective support for our brother Nnamdi Njasi. The overwhelming response solidified trust and demonstrated the collective strength of the alumni.
A defining moment came during the illnes: A defining moment came during the illness of Paul Arisa. Information shared with the group became a catalyst for rapid growth, drawing in many alumni who had been out of touch and creating a platform for more consistent engagement.
Leadership emerged naturally through ser: Leadership emerged naturally through service. Ms. Ella oversaw accounting, documentation, and reports, ensuring transparency. Later, Comr. CHIJIOKE FELIX MADUKA was appointed Chairman of the Caretaker Committee and Reunion Chairman.
Transitioning into a democratically led: Transitioning into a democratically led association, Caleb was elected as President with Anita as Vice President in our first major elections. This marked a significant step in the group's evolution toward a formal structure.
The core vision: to bring together all m: The core vision: to bring together all members under one unified platform, create opportunities for one another, and uphold the values of being one another’s brother’s and sister’s keeper.
Today, we stand stronger together, commi: Today, we stand stronger together, committed to building a lasting legacy for ourselves and future generations.
